mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultations ( user_id, facility_id, preferred_at, consultation_method, message ) VALUES ( #{request.userId}, #{request.facilityId}, #{request.preferredAt}, #{request.consultationMethod}, #{request.message} )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id AS id, c.facility_id AS facilityId, f.name AS facilityName,
DATE_FORMAT( c.preferred_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS preferredAt,
c.consultation_method AS consultationMethod, c.message AS message, c.status AS status,
DATE_FORMAT( c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdAt
FROM consultations c
INNER JOIN facilities f ON c.facility_id = f.id
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status != 'CANCELED'
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
